decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 

The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 23rd October, 2003, the erection of a single storey rear extension that adds 20.41m3 to the volume of the original dwelling, and the erection of a single storey side extension that adds 22.16m3 to the volume of the original dwelling and totalling 42.57m3 to the dwelling, as shown on drawing numbers GA.01/02/10 dated October 2003 is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act and therefore does not require planning permission for the following reason:

The proposed roof extension falls within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the demolition of the existing conservatory and erection of single storey rear extension and single storey part rear infill extension to dwellinghouse.
